### What is a 'Doc Maker'?+

Doc Makers have the power to create new docs and templates, create and manage folders to organize the workspace. Within docs, Doc Makers can administer tasks such as adding pages, changing doc and page titles and icons, adjusting the timezone, configuring doc and page locking, etc.

...

As you grow into Superhuman Docs, you can invite additional members to become Editors or Doc Makers in your workspace.

...

At the end of each billing cycle, you will be billed for the workspace based on the number of Doc Makers in it. Any changes to the number of Doc Makers in the workspace mid-cycle are automatically prorated.

...

When you sign up for a new plan, as well as when it renews, you will be billed up front for all the users in your workspace.

Whenever you add a new paid user to your workspace (or upgrade an existing one), we'll prorate them for the remainder of your billing cycle. On the annual plan, you will be charged monthly for these additional membership changes, with prorations applied for the remainder of the billing year. Additionally, you will be charged whenever your bill exceeds $1,000 from adding new members.

results.title: Superhuman Docs billing and pricing basics – Superhuman Help Center
results.content:
With Docs' unique Maker billing model, we only charge for Doc Makers in paid workspaces. Editors and viewers are entirely free!

ℹ️ A quick note on role definitions:

- Doc Makers are workspace members who have the ability to create docs, create pages, and use Docs AI
- Editors have the ability to update existing pages, but can't create new docs or pages.

To learn more about the different roles and their abilities, check out this comprehensive article.

When you upgrade to a paid plan, you have the choice of paying annually or monthly. You can use your self-service billing account to change payment methods, update billing details, and change pricing plans. For more info on managing your billing account, check out this article.

...

How much does each pricing plan cost?

With our Maker billing model, you only pay for Doc Makers in your workspace. Each pricing plan (Free, Pro, Business, and Enterprise) has a different cost per Doc Maker. To see the cost per Doc Maker, head to our pricing page.
